datasite.rationale: Self-serve developer portal (OAuth 2, API keys) and a vendor MCP server scoped to the user's own permissions, which may cover invited users. Not stated whether buy-side invitees are eligible, and MCP needs account enablement.

ideals-vdr.rationale: The API is an enterprise paid add-on for account owners and managers. Admins can enable the vendor MCP per user group within existing permissions, so a GP could in principle enable it for investors; not confirmed. Terms prohibit unapproved tools.

ansarada.rationale: No public API. Read-only metadata MCP, enabled per room on request and scoped to user permissions; no document content, and guest eligibility not stated. Otherwise web login with MFA.

firmex.rationale: No API, MCP or integrations found on vendor pages; knowledge base blocked. Web login only as far as known.

docsend.rationale: The vendor remote MCP (beta) and the Zapier and Salesforce integrations serve DocSend account users. Visitors get email-verified links and Space update emails; no visitor API documented.

digify.rationale: Documented sender-side REST API (basic-auth keys) and View, Print and Download webhooks; the API manages recipients rather than serving them. Recipients use DRM-protected links.

smartroom.rationale: The vendor claims an API but publishes no docs; recipient access is web only as far as known.

drooms.rationale: No API or MCP mentioned; SSO and 2FA listed; download permissions set per user and document.

netfiles.rationale: No API or interface mentioned on the site or in the terms; Teams integration only. The terms do not address automation.

brainloop.rationale: Security-focused room with 2FA and IRM; no API mentioned. View-only behaviour not confirmed, so not rated 5.

intralinks-vdrpro.rationale: Customer APIs are available through sales. The terms explicitly prohibit bots, spiders and RPA on the platform, so recipient automation is limited to official channels.

flow.rationale: Documented REST API with JWT tokens exists but is issued to the GP organisation on request and covers funds, investors and investments, not documents. LP side is a password web login. Terms prohibit bots, but explicitly allow delegated access to representatives and service providers.

capinteract-lp-interact.rationale: White-label web portal with MFA; no API, SFTP or feed documented for investors.

alter-domus-corpro.rationale: Proprietary web portal; API connectivity offered to clients (GPs), none documented for LPs.

citcoone.rationale: Proprietary web portal behind an OAuth2/OIDC login at login.citco.com; no public API.

gen-ii-sensr-portal.rationale: Proprietary web portal with AI Q&A; DataBridge feeds go to GP systems, nothing documented for LPs.

iq-eq-cosmos.rationale: Dashboards export to PDF, PPT, Excel and CSV; no API documented.

csc-viewpoint.rationale: Web portal only per public material; no API or exports documented.

vistra-vfunds.rationale: Web portal with SSO and MFA; dashboards allow downloads; no API documented.

yardi-investment-manager.rationale: Branded investor web portal; investor-side access channels not checked.

goji.rationale: Onboarding and communications platform; investor data access channels not checked.

finventions-investment-portal.rationale: Password-only web portal with interactive CSV and PDF export; no API, SFTP or notification feed documented.

universal-investment-powerportal.rationale: Rich reporting portal for institutional investors but no published API, SFTP or export documentation.

quantium.rationale: Web portal for LPs; vendor advertises a GP-side API and data warehouse but no public developer documentation and no known LP-side API.

fundrbird.rationale: Web portal for LPs; GP-side BI API mentioned on the vendor site, nothing documented for investors.

fundpanel.rationale: Web portal only as far as public material shows; no API or developer mention on aduroadvisors.com or fundpanel.io.

juniper-square.rationale: LP side is web login with 2FA only. GP-side REST API, webhooks, SFTP and a read-only MCP server exist but are not offered to investors. Terms prohibit automated queries without written permission.

carta.rationale: Publicly documented OAuth API with sandbox and a vendor MCP server, both oriented to fund managers and partners. LP access to own commitments via API or MCP unconfirmed. Email notices give a machine-readable trigger.

allvue-investor-portal.rationale: Web portal only for LPs. APIs are GP-side and undocumented publicly.

efront-investment-cafe.rationale: Hosted web portal per GP or administrator. API is back-office integration for GPs. No public docs, no MCP.

dynamo-investor-portal.rationale: Web portal with email notifications. Vendor API for GP customers only, no public docs.

backstop-client-portal.rationale: Web-only for investors. Licensed REST APIs serve Backstop's own customers.

altvia-sharesecure.rationale: LP portal with 2FA and email notifications. No public API. MCP for GP teams only.

fis-digital-data-exchange.rationale: Web portal. API and file utility integration is GP and administrator side.

sp-global-ilevel.rationale: Customer-only REST API and new MCP server for iLEVEL subscribers. LP access via the Prism portal unverified.

ssc-globeop-investor-portal.rationale: Web portal with PDF statements. No API, SFTP or MCP information published.

intralinks-fundcentre.rationale: GP-side API behind engagement. LP side is web login. Terms prohibit bots and API-key sharing.

investorflow-investor-portal.rationale: Web portal with configurable email notices. No public API. Terms prohibit scraping.

cash-flow-portal.rationale: Vendor MCP server for sponsors. LP side is web login. Terms prohibit access outside supported interfaces.

chronograph-lp.rationale: The LP is the customer: GraphQL and REST API with keys and sandbox, Snowflake share, Excel exports, vendor MCP server. Not fully self-serve.

msci-private-i.rationale: Data and Analytics APIs for authorised LP clients, no public docs, no MCP.

papermark.rationale: Owner side is the best in class: public REST API with OpenAPI, scoped tokens, CLI and a vendor MCP server from a EUR 59 plan. Not a 1 because nothing is offered to the invited LP, who still reaches documents through browser links.

icapital.rationale: No public API; partner-only integration docs; ToS expressly prohibits automated systems and intelligent agents except authorized APIs; documents reachable only via web or via an advisor/custodian integration.

cais.rationale: Advisor-only platform; MCP server in limited release for select advisors; data feed to Tamarac requires setup fee; no public API docs; end investor has no direct programmatic path.

moonfare.rationale: Default 2FA web login; partner API only for distributing institutions (marketing claims, no docs); investor gets PDFs and email notices.

angellist-venture.rationale: Vendor MCP server (AngelList Link) exposes documents, capital calls, distributions and capital accounts read-only but only to GPs; LPs limited to web (optional TOTP 2FA) with PDF/CSV tax exports; LP MCP and API announced as planned.

sydecar.rationale: Magic-link email login; K-1s downloadable in Tax Center; no developer docs; website ToS prohibits robots/spiders and account sharing.

allocate.rationale: Undocumented vendor MCP endpoint behind customer sign-in; no public API; advisor-oriented product; terms silent on automation.

vauban-carta.rationale: Carta MCP server with OAuth scoped to the signed-in user's permissions and a partner-gated REST API/Data Warehouse exist; LP eligibility for MCP undocumented; LP portal offers PDF/XLSX and capital call emails.

odin.rationale: Web portal only; documents on deal pages and by email; no API, MCP or export documentation; MFA unknown.

bunch.rationale: Branded web portal with PDFs; no API/MCP; terms prohibit scraping and automated extraction; delegates must be onboarded as separate users.

roundtable.rationale: Investor dashboard with documents; API only claimed in third-party directories; no developer docs; MFA unknown.

titanbay.rationale: B2B infrastructure with API/FIX/SWIFT connectivity claimed in press releases for banks and wealth managers; no public docs; end investor accesses via distributor.

yieldstreet.rationale: Mandatory 2FA web login, no API/MCP/SFTP, PDF documents only; site redirecting to Willow Wealth so terms could not be verified.

subscribe.rationale: Developer documentation site exists but is gated; API aimed at institutions, fund managers and service providers; investors track capital calls and tax documents in web portal.

alto.rationale: API is partner-only (issuers/platforms, case-by-case) and about funding flows, not investor data retrieval; investor uses web portal.

securitize.rationale: Well-documented public APIs with OAuth and sandbox; an app can retrieve an investor's documents with the investor's OAuth token, but credentials go to applications/issuers and fund reporting data sits in the issuer Domain API; third-party reports a public MCP server.

republic.rationale: Crowdfunding marketplace with nominee LP fund access in Europe; no LP-specific portal, API or export documented; inclusion conditional.

addepar-client-portal.rationale: Fully documented REST API with OpenAPI, Files and Portfolio endpoints, but keys are issued only to the licensing firm; a Client Portal end user has no self-serve API or MCP; firm-level family offices rate 2.

arch.rationale: Aggregator, not a GP portal: documented Client API (OpenAPI, JWT client credentials) exposing holdings, cash flows, activities and tax documents to the investor organisation or its delegate, plus SFTP/flat-file delivery; requires paid Arch subscription and docs are not readable anonymously.

liqid.rationale: Web/app only with Auth0 OIDC login; backend API not exposed; no developer program; export options unknown.

privatize.rationale: B2B2C marketing site only; no API, export or login documentation; positions booked at partner custody banks.

nao.rationale: Retail app-first platform; no API, B2B integration or export documentation; custody at Baader Bank.
